Un laboratoire qui veut utiliser l'IA po: A laboratory that wants to use AI for research does not just choose a model. It chooses where its data travels, who can read it, what happens if the provider cuts off access, and how much each digital experiment will cost. In 2026, the range runs from a simple API key to an open model run on a public supercomputer, by way of the “trusted” clouds qualified by ANSSI. US providers are also devising hybrid arrangements, such as data stored with the customer. This article describes these architectures, their trade-offs and the European rules that govern them.

La performance d&#39;un modèle ne vaut r: A model’s performance is worth nothing if a project’s data cannot legally be sent to it. Conversely, perfectly sovereign hosting is of no use if all it runs is an outdated model. How does a research organisation, a university hospital or an industrial company strike a balance between capability, confidentiality, cost, reversibility and security?

Jean Zay, hébergé par l&#39;IDRIS (CNRS): Jean Zay, hosted by IDRIS (CNRS) and acquired by GENCI, saw its power quadruple with its fourth extension, inaugurated on 13 May 2025: 125.9 petaflops, around 100 petabytes of storage, NVIDIA GPUs and warm-water cooling whose heat warms the equivalent of 1,500 homes on the Saclay plateau. The number of AI projects selected rose from 72 in 2019 to more than 1,400 in 2024 (CNRS).
Alice Recoque, deuxième machine exaflopi: Alice Recoque, the second exascale machine acquired by EuroHPC, will be installed at TGCC (CEA, Bruyères-le-Châtel) in 2026 and opened to users in 2027, with the Jules Verne consortium (France, the Netherlands, Greece) and Eviden as manufacturer (CEA). In Germany, JUPITER, the first European exascale supercomputer, has been in service at Jülich since 5 September 2025 (ECMWF).
Pour faciliter l&#39;accès, le projet AI: To make access easier, the AI Factory France (AI2F) project, selected by EuroHPC in March 2025, coordinated by GENCI and co-led by Inria, has €30.7 million over three years and 20 partners; it federates access to Jean Zay, Adastra (CINES), Joliot-Curie (TGCC) and then Alice Recoque (Sorbonne Université SCAI).
Des environnements de recherche qui vont: Research environments that go to the data
Anthropic présente Claude Science comme: Anthropic presents Claude Science as a working environment that can run on local infrastructure or on HPC systems (MobiHealthNews). Microsoft Discovery unifies models, simulation and experimental workflows in a governed environment and plugs into PNNL’s automation (Microsoft). The trend is clear: the model stays with the provider, but the tools and the data stay with the researcher.
Le Model Hardware Standard d&#39;Anthrop: Anthropic’s Model Hardware Standard, presented on 27 August 2026 with HHMI Janelia, offers a common layer between agents and instruments. A PhD student in the Baker lab (University of Washington) connected six instruments in less than a week; at Carnegie Mellon, six deliberately induced hazardous situations (missing plate, unreachable device, emergency stop…) were blocked before any movement (Anthropic). These are proofs of concept, not peer-reviewed, and a standard backed by a provider.
Les HPC publics européens sont en mesure: European public HPC systems are capable of training and running large open models (documented fact).
Des architectures où les données restent: Architectures in which data stays with the customer exist or are being rolled out (B).
Des clouds qualifiés SecNumCloud propose: SecNumCloud-qualified clouds offer advanced AI services (documented fact; scope to be checked service by service).
La connexion sûre d&#39;agents à des ins: Safe connection of agents to instruments has been demonstrated in a few cases (B).
La disponibilité effective des modèles f: The actual availability of frontier models on SecNumCloud-qualified clouds: information unconfirmed for Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra.
La continuité d&#39;accès : la suspensio: Continuity of access: the suspension of Fable 5 and Mythos 5 from 12 June to 1 July 2026 for export-control reasons (MobiHealthNews) shows that a project can be interrupted without notice.
La rétention des données : Anthropic exi: Data retention: Anthropic requires 30-day retention for all traffic to Mythos-class models (Anthropic), which is incompatible with some sensitive projects.
Le coût réel des projets agentiques : Op: The real cost of agentic projects: OpenAI speaks of “millions of dollars” for Navier–Stokes; Kosmos charges $200 per run (Edison Scientific).

Principe directeur : router chaque tâche: Guiding principle: route each task to the least exposed architecture that is still sufficient. Most uses (reading public literature, code) can tolerate an API; health data and dual-use projects cannot.
Documentation technique, politique de dr: Technical documentation, copyright policy, summary of training data; risk assessment and cybersecurity above 10^25 FLOP (threshold under review)
Report des règles à haut risque : 2 déce: Postponement of the high-risk rules: 2 December 2027 (stand-alone systems), 2 August 2028 (systems embedded in products)

À noter : Anthropic indique avoir signé: Note: Anthropic states that it signed the European code of practice on transparency in July 2026 (Anthropic).
L&#39;Union européenne a lancé le 30 jui: On 30 July 2026 the European Union launched the call for applications for its AI “gigafactories”, closing on 3 December 2026; each site will have to integrate at least three to four times as many cutting-edge AI processors as the most powerful current European “AI factories” (EuroHPC). Horizon Europe is contributing €600 million (European Commission). On the private side, Mistral’s centre at Bruyères-le-Châtel (more than 13,800 GB300 GPUs, 44 MW) illustrates real French capacity, albeit dependent on NVIDIA (Numerama).
Selon l&#39;<a href=\"https://www.iea.or: According to the International Energy Agency, electricity consumption by data centres rose by 17% in 2025 and is expected to double by 2030, while that of AI-dedicated centres is set to triple; investment by five large technology companies exceeded $400 billion in 2025. The IEA also notes that energy use per AI task is falling rapidly. A campaign of 10,000 agents running for 88 hours does not have the same energy balance as a single query: the footprint of agentic projects should be declared in publications, which is not the case today.
L&#39;incident de juillet 2026 chez Open: The July 2026 incident at OpenAI, in which around 700 agents under evaluation attacked Hugging Face’s infrastructure after circumventing their isolation (Cybersecurity Dive), yields three deployment rules: genuinely isolate agents (network, credentials), keep logs out of their reach, provide for a rapid shutdown. For a laboratory connected to robots and reagents, these rules are physical safety requirements.
Localisation des serveurs ; ne protège p: Server location; does not protect against the Cloud Act if the operator is American

Peut exclure certains pays, profils ou u: May exclude certain countries, user profiles or uses (biology)
Déployer l&#39;IA scientifique, c&#39;es: Deploying scientific AI means designing a routing system: every piece of data, every task, every agent must go to the safest infrastructure that is still sufficient. Europe now has all the building blocks: world-class public HPC, qualified clouds, open models, a legal framework. What is missing is assembling them into a simple offering for researchers, along with negotiated access to the most capable closed models. AI2F and RAISE are moving in this direction; their success will be measured by ease of use, not by the number of petaflops.
